setup.title: How to connect a planetarium app
setup.footer: Coordinates exchanged in J2000 (ICRS). GoTo slews the mount; Sync updates the mount's pointing model. Stop/Abort halts any ongoing slew.

manifest.name: LX200 Server
manifest.description: Virtual LX200 telescope server. Connect Stellarium, SkySafari, Cartes du Ciel, TheSkyX, Voyager, or any LX200-compatible planetarium app to display the mount position and issue GoTo / Sync commands.
